name: SLK Halo XL Power Paddle
description: The SLK Halo XL is an extended-length power paddle with a textured Rev-Tec fiberglass face and a 13 mm polymer core. Its 16.5-inch elongated body adds reach and leverage on serves and drives, aimed at singles players and baseliners who want easy power on a budget.
care_instructions: Wipe the face with a damp cloth after play. Keep the paddle in a cover to protect the textured surface and avoid extreme heat.
